column1: # Jabeja fork only: every live OpenMausBot that fork/deploy-beast.sh rolls out
# to, one per line (SSOT). Same image everywhere; each its own container,
# port, code and data. The port is the server's inside its container; paths
# are relative to $HOME on the host; the live folder holds DEPLOYED_COMMIT.
# Host "beast" means $BEAST_HOST (fork/beast.sh). Builds always run on the
# beast; another host gets the built release copied over.
# ripal runs inside VM hermes-vm on node1 (159.69.74.253), port published on
# 100.86.49.68:8811 (tailnet only). Its paths are absolute, not under $HOME, and
# there is no ssh alias "hermes-vm" yet (reached via node1 + incus exec), so
# deploy-beast.sh --instance ripal does not work as written yet.
